content: Letter 20, headed by MK 'To Amīrzāda Shāhrukh' (ca. 829/1426, Yazd?): Ibn Turka greets the sultan and says his objective in serving the Sharīʿa is twofold: to be blameless before the Prophet and to further Shāhrukh's Sharīʿa-promoting mission. He has accordingly sent a darvīsh to Shāhrukh's court to discuss a number of considerations to this end (TMN/MS p. 17, TMN/D pp. 182-83).
